reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: PROSEAD Component 3: Value Chain Development for Integrated Agro-Industrial Parks (IAIPs) Sustained Growth (Support to Agriculture Value Chain)

description.narrative: The project intends to promote and ensure the functioning of market-driven value chain development (priority value chains) for increased farm income through production and supply of standard raw materials to the agro-industrial parks under an inclusive and environmentally sustainable approach. It will attain the following: (1) increase in yield for selected value chain commodities by targeted households in target ACC Woredas serving the IAIPs raw material requirements; (2) increase in number of farmers applying new technologies and management practices; (3) increase in number of farmers accessing inputs, credit and other services; (4) increases in volume of standard raw materials supplied to IAIPs, (5) improved institutional capacity and enabling environment for commercialization.
